prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Personality Quiz Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into an interactive quiz stage layout where users select preferences to find their ideal pet match. (why: Adoption conversion is only 60.9% with long decision times (median 89s), indicating difficulty choosing a pet.)
1: [home, wait_info] Real-Time Render Diagnostic Progress: Show detailed rendering progress bars and troubleshooting hints on the waiting screen while the pet initializes. (why: Waiting stage mean time is very high (2336s) and support reported instances of pet failing to display on desktop.)
2: [choose_path, hint] Desktop Path Comparison Hints: Display feature comparison hints on the path selection screen highlighting resource usage and interactivity differences. (why: Choose path mean duration is 514s, showing user hesitation during path selection.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Sync Reassurance Copy: Update sign-in screen copy to explicitly explain that signing in prevents pet loss across device restarts. (why: 8 emails reported lost or reset pets upon re-signing in.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Story Scroll Introduction Layout: Change the initial story intro layout to a story scroll format featuring interactive mascot previews. (why: Initial onboarding conversion drops off early at choose_path stage (76.2%).)
5: [finish, notification] Desktop Visibility Helper Banner: Add a tip carousel banner explaining how to summon or unhide missing pets from the system tray. (why: Support received reports of pets not showing on desktop or misbehaving after setup.)
